summary: Backend-only regression of the Claude Sonnet 4.5 -> claude-sonnet-5-5 model swap. Model id resolves fine (backend.err.log shows 'model= claude-sonnet-5-5' with no model-not-found/invalid-model errors). PASSING: guidance generation on a cache miss (Edinburgh, month 3, async job -> done, structured plant_now/harvest_now/tasks/pests), Masterclass generate -> job done -> lessons, Instagram preview CAROUSEL (caption + 3 tips) and SOW (caption + plants), Ask Nàdar multi-turn (this still runs on Haiku, as intended), and the calm author endpoint returning already_exists without overwriting. FAILING (3 of 3 runs plus direct repro): 2-Minute Calm script authoring (calm.py, max_tokens=2500) returns JSON that is cut off partway, so json.loads fails and the endpoint returns 500. Social share captions (share_social_captions.py, max_tokens=1500) return JSON that is cut off, so the code silently falls back to template captions. Root cause: on claude-sonnet-5-5, max_tokens cuts output off far earlier than on 4.5 (probably internal reasoning/thinking tokens count against the budget). Isolated repro: the same ~500-token prompt with max_tokens=1500 returns None on 5-5, a full answer on 5-5 with max_tokens=6000, and a full answer on 4.5 with max_tokens=1500.

critical.issue: claude-sonnet-5-5 output is cut off at ~1.1-1.3k chars, partway through the transcript_display JSON string. json.loads raises JSONDecodeError ('Unterminated string' / "Expecting ','"), which surfaces as a 500. Reproduced 2/2.

critical.endpoint: GET /api/share/patch/{id}/captions.json and the social-kit ZIP (share_social_captions.py line 133 max_tokens=1500)
critical.issue: Output is cut off at ~2.3k chars, so the JSON is invalid. The log says 'Caption LLM returned non-JSON — using templates' and users always get the template fallback captions instead of AI ones. Silent regression. Reproduced 3/3.

minor.issue: Worked in both previews, but these budgets are tight given the 5-5 truncation behaviour. If output is empty or cut off, the code silently falls back to the generic tips/caption. The tips also ignored the 'max 14 words' rule (16-18 words each).

action_items: Raise or remove max_tokens for claude-sonnet-5-5 calls: calm.py:251 (2500 -> ~8000), share_social_captions.py:133 (1500 -> ~6000), instagram.py:544 (400 -> ~2000) and :576 (200 -> ~1500). masterclass.py already uses 10000 and works; core._llm_json sets none and works.
After the fix, rerun: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sonnet55_upgrade_iter57.py -k 'Calm or ShareCaptions'
Optional: when a JSON parse fails, log the raw response length so silent fallbacks can be spotted
critical_code_review_comments: share_social_captions and instagram helpers swallow every LLM failure and fall back to templates, which hid this regression (the HTTP status is still 200)
Docstrings and comments still say 'Claude Sonnet 4.5' (core._llm_json) and 'Claude Haiku' (generate_captions); update them

rca of the issue: Repro: python /app/backend/tests/_debug_maxtok_iter57.py. With claude-sonnet-5-5 and max_tokens=1500, a 15-sentence prompt returns None; with max_tokens=6000 it returns the full answer (~2.0k chars); claude-sonnet-4-5 with 1500 returns the full answer. So on 5-5, max_tokens appears to include internal reasoning tokens and the visible output is cut off. Fix: raise max_tokens at the call sites that set it.
